Syrian refugees in both Lebanon and Norway report a relatively good health status, however, there are substantial shares reporting chronic pain and mental disorders, as well as a substantial share of non-communicables diseases not being properly treated.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the health status of refugees is a dynamic process and should be assessed along the migration pathway.
the health status of Syrian refugees is not necessarily worse than that of the general populations in Lebanon and Norway.
